ruling.text: BrokerCheck is OK'd as a source. FDU is not selling this product.
ruling.what_it_settles: The USE dimension. BrokerCheck 'Permitted Uses' allows 'your own personal or professional use'; FDU's use is personal/professional research and is not communicated, sold, leased, loaned, distributed, transferred or sublicensed to any third party.
ruling.what_it_does_not_settle: The COLLECTION-METHOD dimension. Restriction (e) bars data mining/scraping/harvesting tools (including robots) independently of whether data is sold, and is lifted only by the investor-protection/academic/compliance/regulatory carve-out, which does not list personal or professional research. Automation intensity, not commercial intent, is the live variable.
ruling.engineering_consequence: Prefer the SEC IAPD IA_INDVL bulk feed for any bulk individual data - it carries substantially the same fields under an explicitly permissive SEC clause - and reserve BrokerCheck for targeted, human-paced lookups. This satisfies the ruling without loading restriction (e).
